summary: Li Auto Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching Next Day Disclosure Returns under Hong Kong listing rules, reporting daily share repurchases from April 24 to May 7, 2026. On April 24, it repurchased 385,766 shares at USD 8.9725/share (volume-weighted), adding 385,766 shares to treasury, reducing issued shares from 1,804,097,493 to 1,803,711,727. The company is executing an ongoing buyback program, signaling capital return to shareholders. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The filing is a routine disclosure of share buybacks, not a transformative event. Watch for further buyback pacing and potential impact on share count and earnings per share.
